rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona, visible ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the reported 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a single static image. Slight uncertainty between full vs expanded and some image-specific detail is necessarily limited.
Strongly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrial thickness, smoking, BMI, first-cycle status, male factor context, and embryo quality into overall prognosis and counseling.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately tied to embryo grade and patient age while adjusting for smoking/BMI. Minor issue: some extrapolation from morphology to euploidy/implantation is broad but still reasonable.

Recommendations are well aligned with IVF practice guidelines: eSET in a young patient with a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, no routine PGT-A in this first-cycle low-risk setting, and emphasis on smoking cessation and standard transfer support.

Provides clear practical steps for current transfer and contingency planning if unsuccessful, including eSET, luteal support adherence, smoking cessation, and future-cycle review. Useful though not highly protocol-specific.
